objective: Proof. The not-exactly-two and twelve classes have five-point pieces without repeated lines that force two ports equal and leave two free. A regularization (equality cycles of copies, free ports absorbed) maps every signed instance to a simple 4-regular 4-uniform system without repeated lines with the same satisfiability. With Schaefer, deciding these classes on 4-regular systems is NP-complete, so their failures are coNP-complete to recognise. Check the pieces by enumeration and the reduction end to end with a SAT solver.
status: Proved by FOUR-PLACE-20261031-001C-P001: the not-exactly-two and twelve classes have five-point link pieces without repeated lines (two ports forced equal, two free on different lines); equality cycles of copies with free ports absorbed regularize any signed instance to a simple 4-regular 4-uniform system without repeated lines with the same satisfiability (160/160 against a SAT solver), so with Schaefer both are NP-complete on 4-regular systems and their failures are coNP-complete
title: The other value-free four-place laws build equality and are NP-complete
